+## What
+1. plan.md §8.1 says that `start` renders the body and makes the session, and that "both are synchronous". The code awaits the skills preload and the tool makers. Correct the text: the setup is async, and `start` returns after the session exists.
+2. `README.md` says "`name` and `description` are necessary". Plan §4.3 says a missing or different `name` gives a warning and the file loads, because the file name is the id. Correct the README.
+3. Before `registry.load()`, `runner.start` throws `unknownAgent(available: [])`, and `AgentsTool.make` gives "No agents are installed now." with no hint. Add `AgentRegistry.isLoaded`. `runner.start` throws a new `AgentRunnerError.catalogNotLoaded` before the first load, and `AgentsTool.make` throws the same error.
+4. `AgentRunner.run(completionToken:)` and the token map are used only by tests. Remove them and the token entry of plan §9.3, unless a production caller needs them. Decide from the code, and write the reason on the task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Plan §8.1 and the README say what the code does.
+- [ ] `runner.start` and `AgentsTool.make` before `load()` throw `catalogNotLoaded`; after `load()` they work as now.
+- [ ] The token index is removed, or has a production caller that a test covers.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Cases in `AgentRunnerTests.swift` and `AgentsToolDescriptionTests.swift` for `catalogNotLoaded`.
+- [ ] `ReadmeExampleTests` and `DocumentationTests` pass.
+- [ ] Run `swift test -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
